reels.caption:
Most people walk into a home and only see what it is today. Smart buyers and investors see what it can become.

When purchasing real estate, two things matter most: location and space. You can always update cosmetics, renovate interiors, and improve condition—but you can't change where the property sits, and adding square footage can be costly.

That's exactly what I saw in this property: a prime location and a 75x100 lot with the potential to subdivide into two multifamily homes.

Vision creates opportunity. What others overlook can become your next slam dunk.

reels.caption:
Installing a urinal above 65cm can result in several issues, such as discomfort for users and inefficient use of bathroom space. When positioned too high, it might not be accessible or comfortable for all users, especially children or shorter individuals. This can lead to a frustrating experience and potential issues with proper use.

Fix:

To address this problem, ensure the urinal is installed at approximately 65cm from the floor. This height provides a more comfortable and practical design, accommodating a wider range of users and improving overall usability. By following this guideline, you'll enhance both the functionality and user experience of your bathroom space.

#BathroomDesign #InteriorDesign #DesignTips #HomeImprovement #UserFriendlyDesign #RenovationTips #DesignSolutions #functionaldesign
